summary: Iteration 74: Double-tap like feature testing. Code review confirms implementation is correct. UI testing blocked by Feed page loading issue - page stuck on spinner because /api/feed is never called. Root cause: FeedPage.jsx doesn't check AuthContext's loading state before redirecting to login when user is null.

integration_issues.issue: Feed page stuck on loading spinner. The /api/feed endpoint is never called. Root cause: FeedPage.jsx line 87-91 checks if user is null and navigates to /login, but doesn't wait for AuthContext's loading state to complete. This creates a race condition where the page mounts before AuthContext finishes fetching user data.
integration_issues.suggested_fix: In FeedPage.jsx, import 'loading' from useAuth() and add check: if (loading) return <LoadingSpinner />; before the user null check

action_items: FIX REQUIRED: FeedPage.jsx needs to check AuthContext's loading state before checking if user is null. Add: const { user, token, isAdmin, loading: authLoading } = useAuth(); and if (authLoading) return loading spinner before the user null check.

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Feed page stuck on loading spinner
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: FeedPage.jsx useEffect (lines 87-95) checks if user is null and navigates to /login without first checking if AuthContext is still loading. When navigating to /feed, the component mounts before AuthContext finishes fetching user data from /api/auth/me, so user is temporarily null.
reproduction_steps: 3. Feed page shows loading spinner indefinitely
4. /api/feed is never called (verified via network monitoring)
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Add loading state check from AuthContext before user null check in FeedPage.jsx
